logline: 극장 어딘가에서 노랫소리를 듣던 젊은 가수가, 거울 뒤로 이어진 계단을 내려간다.
destination: 극장 지하의 검은 호수 — 목소리의 주인이 사는 자리
protagonist: 합창단에서 갑자기 주역이 된 젊은 소프라노
setting: 1880년대 파리 오페라 극장, 무대와 분장실과 지하
anchor: a slight young soprano in a pale stage gown with loose chestnut hair, gilded Paris opera house
palette: gilt gold and crimson velvet, candle flame, black water, deep stage shadow

beats.beat: 젊은 가수가 극장 지붕 위로 올라온다.
beats.visual: a young soprano stepping onto a vast opera house roof among bronze statues, city rooftops beyond
beats.motion: wind lifts her gown, cloud shadow crosses the bronze, her hair whips back

beats.visual: a young soprano turning toward a tall dressing room mirror, candles doubled in its surface
beats.motion: candle flames double and waver in the glass, she turns, a comb slips off the table

beats.beat: 무대 위 거대한 샹들리에가 크게 흔들린다.
beats.visual: an enormous crystal chandelier swaying above a packed auditorium, faces turning up toward it
beats.motion: the chandelier swings wide, crystals chime, hundreds of heads tilt back

beats.beat: 오번 특별석은 늘 비워 두라는 지시가 온다.
beats.visual: an empty velvet box seat in a full opera house, red curtain half drawn across it
beats.motion: the box curtain stirs, the audience settles below, gaslight steadies

beats.visual: a tall mirror swung inward like a door revealing a black stone passage, a young soprano before it
beats.motion: the mirror swings inward, cold air pushes her gown, candle flames bend

beats.beat: 그녀는 촛불을 든 형체를 따라 계단을 내려간다.
beats.visual: a masked figure in black holding a candle leading a young woman down a spiral stone stair
beats.motion: the candle descends ahead of her, shadows wheel on the wall, her hem drags

beats.visual: a white half mask turned toward a young woman across a candlelit underground chamber
beats.motion: her hand rises toward the mask, candles gutter together, water laps stone

beats.visual: a single candle guttering on a stone ledge above still black underground water, boat gone
beats.motion: the flame leans and recovers, reflections break apart, water laps stone

withheld: 가면 아래 얼굴과, 놓아주며 맞는 마지막
